# `gcp.tlsroute`

TlsRoute defines how traffic should be routed based on SNI and other matching L3 attributes.

[networkservices](README.md) · [all services](../README.md)

| Service | networkservices |
| Scope | regional |
| Asset type | `networkservices.googleapis.com/TlsRoute` |

Any one of these shapes is accepted, tried in order:
